WITH loc_canon AS (
  SELECT l0.id AS location_id, COALESCE(c.canon_id, l0.id) AS canon_id
  FROM bill_management_v2.locations l0
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT payload->>'site_number' AS site_number, MIN(id) AS canon_id
             FROM bill_management_v2.locations
             WHERE customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }} AND deleted_at IS NULL
               AND lower(btrim(payload->>'site_status')) IN ('operational', 'active', 'open')
             GROUP BY 1) c ON c.site_number = l0.payload->>'site_number'
  WHERE l0.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }}
),
acct_meter AS (
  SELECT va.account_code,
         regexp_replace(upper(btrim(va.meter_serial)), '^1([0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]?)\Z', 'I\1') AS meter_key,
         MIN(f.statement_date) AS first_bill,
         MAX(f.statement_date) AS last_bill,
         BOOL_OR(s.account_status IS NULL OR lower(btrim(s.account_status)) <> 'closed') AS is_open
  FROM bill_management_v2.virtual_accounts va
  JOIN bill_management_v2.analytics_monthly_feed f ON f.virtual_account_id = va.id
  LEFT JOIN bill_management_v2.virtual_accounts_status s ON s.virtual_account_id = va.id
  WHERE va.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }} AND va.meter_serial ~ '[0-9]'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
superseded AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.account_code
  FROM acct_meter a
  JOIN acct_meter b ON b.meter_key = a.meter_key AND b.account_code <> a.account_code
                  AND b.first_bill > a.first_bill AND b.last_bill > a.last_bill AND b.is_open
),
cpv_one AS (
  SELECT customer_id, code,
         MIN(name) AS name,
         MIN(remittance_name) AS remittance_name,
         MIN(main_phone) AS main_phone,
         (ARRAY_AGG(remittance_address))[1] AS remittance_address
  FROM bill_management_v2.customers_providers_vendors
  WHERE customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }}
  GROUP BY customer_id, code
),
pv_one AS (
  SELECT code,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT btrim(name)) = 1 THEN MIN(name) END AS name,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT btrim(remittance_name)) = 1 THEN MIN(remittance_name) END AS remittance_name,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT btrim(main_phone)) = 1 THEN MIN(main_phone) END AS main_phone,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN (ARRAY_AGG(remittance_address))[1] END AS remittance_address
  FROM bill_management_v2.providers_vendors
  WHERE code IN (SELECT vendor_code FROM bill_management_v2.analytics_monthly_feed
                 WHERE customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }})
  GROUP BY code
),
vas_one AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.virtual_account_id)
         s.virtual_account_id, s.account_status, s.account_opened, s.account_closed
  FROM bill_management_v2.virtual_accounts_status s
  JOIN bill_management_v2.virtual_accounts sva ON sva.id = s.virtual_account_id
  WHERE sva.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }}
  ORDER BY s.virtual_account_id, s.account_closed DESC NULLS LAST
),
rv_one AS (
  SELECT customer_id, vendor_code,
         NULLIF(btrim(MIN(providers_vendors_attributes::jsonb ->> 'Vendor Code')), '') AS fiq_vendor_id
  FROM bill_management_v2.reports_vendors
  WHERE customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }}
  GROUP BY customer_id, vendor_code
),
attr_vals AS (
  SELECT vam.virtual_account_id,
         vmeta.attribute_name,
         string_agg(DISTINCT vam.attribute_value, ' | ' ORDER BY vam.attribute_value) AS val
  FROM bill_management_v2.virtual_accounts_attributes_mapping vam
  JOIN bill_management_v2.virtual_accounts_attributes_metadata vmeta
    ON vmeta.id = vam.virtual_accounts_attributes_metadata_id
  WHERE vmeta.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }}
    AND vmeta.deleted_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY vam.virtual_account_id, vmeta.attribute_name
),
feed_scoped AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (virtual_account_id, location_id, utility_type) * FROM bill_management_v2.analytics_monthly_feed WHERE customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }} ORDER BY virtual_account_id, location_id, utility_type, time_period DESC NULLS LAST
),
amf_first AS (
  SELECT va2.account_code, f.location_id, f.vendor_code,
         MIN(f.time_period) AS first_period,
         MAX(f.statement_date) AS last_bill_date
  FROM bill_management_v2.analytics_monthly_feed f
  JOIN bill_management_v2.virtual_accounts va2 ON va2.id = f.virtual_account_id
  WHERE f.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }}
    AND f.location_id IN (SELECT ls.id FROM bill_management_v2.locations ls WHERE ls.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }} AND ('{{ String(LocationInput.text || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = '' OR ls.payload->>'site_number' = '{{ String(LocationInput.text || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}'))
  GROUP BY va2.account_code, f.location_id, f.vendor_code
),
bill_history AS (
  SELECT ah.bill_id,
         ah.virtual_account_id,
         upper(btrim(ah.commodity)) AS commodity,
         MIN(ah.start_date)  AS start_date,
         MAX(ah.end_date)    AS end_date,
         SUM(ah.subcharges)  AS subcharges,
         SUM(ah.consumption) AS consumption
  FROM bill_management_v2.account_history ah
  JOIN bill_management_v2.virtual_accounts bva ON bva.id = ah.virtual_account_id
  WHERE bva.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }}
  GROUP BY ah.bill_id, ah.virtual_account_id, upper(btrim(ah.commodity))
),
gl_rows AS (
  SELECT vam.virtual_account_id,
         (substring(vmeta.attribute_name from '([0-9]+)'))::int AS gl_slot,
         MAX(NULLIF(btrim(vam.attribute_value), '')) FILTER (WHERE vmeta.attribute_name ~* '^gl\s*code')  AS gl_code,
         MAX(NULLIF(btrim(vam.attribute_value), '')) FILTER (WHERE vmeta.attribute_name ~* '^gl\s*alloc') AS gl_allocation
  FROM bill_management_v2.virtual_accounts_attributes_mapping vam
  JOIN bill_management_v2.virtual_accounts_attributes_metadata vmeta
    ON vmeta.id = vam.virtual_accounts_attributes_metadata_id
  WHERE vmeta.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }}
    AND vmeta.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND vmeta.attribute_name ~* '^gl\s*(code|alloc)'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
otc_bill AS (
  SELECT li.bill_id, upper(btrim(li.commodity)) AS commodity, SUM(li.charge) AS otc
  FROM bill_management_v2.analytics_billing_line_items li
  WHERE li.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }}
    AND li.code IN ('OTH_FEE','OTH_PENALTY','OTH_DEPOSIT','OTH_DEPOSITINT','OTH_CORR_CHARGE','OTH_ADJUSTMENT')
    AND li.location_id IN (SELECT ls.id FROM bill_management_v2.locations ls WHERE ls.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }} AND ('{{ String(LocationInput.text || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = '' OR ls.payload->>'site_number' = '{{ String(LocationInput.text || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}'))
  GROUP BY li.bill_id, upper(btrim(li.commodity))
),
otc_rows AS (
  SELECT f.bill_id, upper(btrim(f.utility_type)) AS commodity, COUNT(*) AS feed_rows
  FROM bill_management_v2.analytics_monthly_feed f
  WHERE f.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }}
    AND f.location_id IN (SELECT ls.id FROM bill_management_v2.locations ls WHERE ls.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }} AND ('{{ String(LocationInput.text || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = '' OR ls.payload->>'site_number' = '{{ String(LocationInput.text || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}'))
  GROUP BY f.bill_id, upper(btrim(f.utility_type))
),
lf_bills AS (
  SELECT f.virtual_account_id, f.bill_id,
         MIN(f.bill_record_id)       AS bill_record_id,
         MIN(f.statement_date)::date AS bill_date,
         SUM(f.total_charges)        AS bill_amount
  FROM bill_management_v2.analytics_monthly_feed f
  WHERE f.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }}
    AND f.location_id IN (SELECT ls.id FROM bill_management_v2.locations ls WHERE ls.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }} AND ('{{ String(LocationInput.text || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = '' OR ls.payload->>'site_number' = '{{ String(LocationInput.text || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}'))
  GROUP BY f.virtual_account_id, f.bill_id
),
lf_fee AS (
  SELECT li.virtual_account_id, li.bill_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN li.charge > 0 THEN li.charge ELSE 0 END) AS late_fee_charged,
         SUM(CASE WHEN li.charge < 0 THEN li.charge ELSE 0 END) AS late_fee_recouped,
         SUM(li.charge)                                         AS late_fee
  FROM bill_management_v2.analytics_billing_line_items li
  WHERE li.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }}
    AND li.code = 'LATEFEE'
    AND li.location_id IN (SELECT ls.id FROM bill_management_v2.locations ls WHERE ls.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }} AND ('{{ String(LocationInput.text || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = '' OR ls.payload->>'site_number' = '{{ String(LocationInput.text || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}'))
  GROUP BY li.virtual_account_id, li.bill_id
),
lf_seq AS (
  SELECT b.virtual_account_id, b.bill_id, b.bill_date, b.bill_amount,
         fee.late_fee, fee.late_fee_charged, fee.late_fee_recouped,
         LAG(b.bill_date)      OVER w AS prev_bill_date,
         LAG(b.bill_amount)    OVER w AS prev_bill_amount,
         LAG(b.bill_record_id) OVER w AS prev_bill_record_id
  FROM lf_bills b
  LEFT JOIN lf_fee fee ON fee.virtual_account_id = b.virtual_account_id AND fee.bill_id = b.bill_id
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY b.virtual_account_id ORDER BY b.bill_date, b.bill_id)
)
SELECT DISTINCT l.name AS "location", lt.location_number AS "locationNumber", l.address AS "locationAddress", l.city AS "locationCity", CASE WHEN l.state ~ '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z]-' THEN substring(l.state from 4) ELSE l.state END AS "locationState", l.postcode AS "locationZip", CASE upper(btrim(l.country)) WHEN 'US' THEN 'United States' WHEN 'USA' THEN 'United States' WHEN 'CA' THEN 'Canada' WHEN 'CAN' THEN 'Canada' WHEN 'MX' THEN 'Mexico' WHEN 'GB' THEN 'United Kingdom' WHEN 'UK' THEN 'United Kingdom' ELSE l.country END AS "locationCountry", lt.location_phone AS "locationPhone", CASE WHEN lower(btrim(lt.location_status)) IN ('operational','active','open') THEN 'Active' WHEN lower(btrim(lt.location_status)) IN ('closed','inactive','terminated','cancelled','canceled') THEN 'Inactive' ELSE lt.location_status END AS "locationStatus", l.square_feet AS "squareFeet", COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(cvpn.pretty_name), ''), CASE WHEN lower(regexp_replace(btrim(v.pretty_name), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) <> lower(regexp_replace(amf.vendor_code, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) THEN NULLIF(btrim(v.pretty_name), '') END, NULLIF(btrim(cpv.name), ''), NULLIF(btrim(pv.name), ''), amf.vendor_code) AS "vendor", COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim((cpv.remittance_address).line_1), ''), NULLIF(btrim((pv.remittance_address).line_1), '')) AS "vendorAddress1", COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim((cpv.remittance_address).line_2), ''), NULLIF(btrim((pv.remittance_address).line_2), '')) AS "vendorAddress2", COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim((cpv.remittance_address).city), ''), NULLIF(btrim((pv.remittance_address).city), '')) AS "vendorCity", COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim((cpv.remittance_address).state), ''), NULLIF(btrim((pv.remittance_address).state), '')) AS "vendorState", COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim((cpv.remittance_address).post_code), ''), NULLIF(btrim((pv.remittance_address).post_code), '')) AS "vendorZip", COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim((cpv.remittance_address).country), ''), NULLIF(btrim((pv.remittance_address).country), '')) AS "vendorCountry", COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(cpv.main_phone), ''), NULLIF(btrim(pv.main_phone), '')) AS "vendorPhone", va.account_code AS "accountNumber", regexp_replace(va.account_code, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g') AS "cleanAccountNumber", CASE WHEN lower(btrim(vas.account_status)) IN ('closed','inactive','terminated','cancelled','canceled') THEN 'Inactive' WHEN lower(btrim(vas.account_status)) IN ('active','open') THEN 'Active' ELSE vas.account_status END AS "accountStatus", TO_CHAR(COALESCE(vas.account_closed, af.first_period), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "accountActivityDate", TO_CHAR(af.first_period, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "accountCreatedDate", NULLIF(va.client_account, va.account_code) AS "summaryAccount", CASE upper(btrim(amf.utility_type)) WHEN 'ELECTRIC' THEN 'Electric' WHEN 'WATER' THEN 'Water' WHEN 'SEWER' THEN 'Sewer' WHEN 'NATURALGAS' THEN 'Natural Gas' WHEN 'FIREPROTECTION' THEN 'Fire Protection' WHEN 'STORMWATER' THEN 'Storm Water' WHEN 'IRRIGATION' THEN 'Irrigation' WHEN 'LIGHTING' THEN 'Lighting' WHEN 'REFUSE' THEN 'Refuse' WHEN 'SOLARPV' THEN 'Solar PV' WHEN 'CHILLEDWATER' THEN 'Chilled Water' WHEN 'PROPANE' THEN 'Propane' ELSE amf.utility_type END AS "utilityType", va.meter_serial AS "meterSerial", TO_CHAR(af.last_bill_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "lastBillDate"
FROM feed_scoped amf
		LEFT JOIN loc_canon lc ON lc.location_id = amf.location_id
		LEFT JOIN bill_management_v2.locations l ON l.id = COALESCE(lc.canon_id, amf.location_id)
		LEFT JOIN bill_management_v2.location_detail lt ON lt.location_id = l.id
		LEFT JOIN bill_management_v2.virtual_accounts va ON va.id = amf.virtual_account_id
		LEFT JOIN bill_management_v2.vendors v ON v.code = amf.vendor_code
		LEFT JOIN bill_management_v2.customers_vendors_pretty_name cvpn ON cvpn.vendor_id = v.id AND cvpn.customer_id = amf.customer_id
		LEFT JOIN cpv_one cpv ON cpv.code = amf.vendor_code AND cpv.customer_id = amf.customer_id
		LEFT JOIN pv_one pv ON pv.code = amf.vendor_code
		LEFT JOIN vas_one vas ON vas.virtual_account_id = amf.virtual_account_id
		LEFT JOIN rv_one rv ON rv.vendor_code = amf.vendor_code AND rv.customer_id = amf.customer_id
		LEFT JOIN amf_first af ON COALESCE(af.account_code, '') = COALESCE(va.account_code, '') AND COALESCE(af.location_id, -1) = COALESCE(amf.location_id, -1) AND COALESCE(af.vendor_code, '') = COALESCE(amf.vendor_code, '')
WHERE 1=1 AND amf.location_id IN (SELECT ls.id FROM bill_management_v2.locations ls WHERE ls.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }} AND ('{{ String(LocationInput.text || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = '' OR ls.payload->>'site_number' = '{{ String(LocationInput.text || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}')) AND (vas.account_status IS NULL OR lower(btrim(vas.account_status)) <> 'closed') AND va.account_code NOT IN (SELECT account_code FROM superseded) AND amf.customer_id = {{ Number(CustomerPick.selectedOptionValue) || 0 }} AND lt.location_status IN ('Operational') AND ('{{ String(LocationInput.text || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = '' OR lt.location_number = '{{ String(LocationInput.text || '').trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}')

ORDER BY "location", "locationNumber", "locationAddress", "locationCity", "locationState", "locationZip", "locationCountry", "locationPhone", "locationStatus", "squareFeet", "vendor", "vendorAddress1", "vendorAddress2", "vendorCity", "vendorState", "vendorZip", "vendorCountry", "vendorPhone", "accountNumber", "cleanAccountNumber", "accountStatus", "accountActivityDate", "accountCreatedDate", "summaryAccount", "utilityType", "meterSerial", "lastBillDate";
